in_marathi.name: Harindra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hari (God Vishnu) + Indra (God of rain and thunder)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harindra is a combination of two powerful Hindu deities, Hari (God Vishnu) and Indra (God of rain and thunder). This name is believed to bring the blessings of both deities, invoking their strength, power, and protection.
